title: Add the items of a TODO file on the Desktop to Reminders

source.licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0; ported by reference (our own instruction, items, setup and checks; no source text copied)
source.changes: Instruction and the four to-do items are our own; the items are a param of three sets (the source's own items are not copied, so they can't be a pick). The source wrote TODO.txt over a clean AMI snapshot and read every open reminder on the Mac in list order; here setup moves an existing Desktop/TODO.txt aside, and the check reads only reminders made since setup, sorted, so reminders the Mac already had don't count and the order the agent adds them in doesn't matter. Teardown deletes the reminders made in the run and puts the Mac's own file back.

setup.why: Note the start time, move the Mac's own Desktop/TODO.txt aside, write this run's TODO.txt with four items, and quit Reminders.

instruction: The file TODO.txt on my Desktop lists a few things I need to do. Add each of them to Reminders.

checks.why: The open reminders made since setup, in any list, are exactly the file's four items, one reminder each, word for word (sorted, so the order doesn't matter). After setup there are none, so an agent that does nothing fails.

teardown.why: Delete the reminders made since setup.
Quit Reminders and TextEdit, delete the run's TODO.txt and put the Mac's own file back.

oracle.why: Make one reminder for each item of the file, in the default list.
